🎯 How to Play
Darts Baseball
The Basics
• Played on a real dartboard — this app is for scoring only
• 3 darts each inning for each player
• Most runs after 9 innings wins
• Tied with top score = extra innings for all players until solitary winner!
How to Score — shown for Inning 1
Blue outlined area = scores runs · grey area = miss
💡 Each inning has its own target number (1→9). The board highlights it automatically. Bulls always score — any inning.
Players (1–8)

⚠️ Open in a web browser (e.g. Safari, Chrome). This may not be the default app on your device. If the player fields don’t appear, that is the likely problem.
